name: Moh7312023NutritionBase
description: Nutrition assessments behind section 3.6 of the MOH 731 (Ver. July 2023) form. One row per patient per location: the malnutrition finding and the feeding support sit on separate observations, so they are folded onto the patient before either is counted. Concepts are the ones the register already reads - 7369 carries the finding (9471 severe, 9472 moderate) and 5484 the supplement (2355).

columns.comment: Banded on the patient's age when they were assessed rather than when the report is run, so a report of a past month does not move its patients between bands as time passes.
